players.product: photonic quantum systems built on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) chips

quarterly_data.signal: Quantum Computing Inc investor presentation (October 2026): QCi has 300+ employees in 11 locations; its next-12-month priorities include publishing head-to-head 10,000-variable Dirac-3 benchmarking results and delivering upgraded systems, the full commercial launch of NeuraWave photonic reservoir computing with Planck Dynamics, more deliveries of its entanglement-based Quantum Secure QKD system, a compact field-deployable vibrometer module, Fab 2 expansion and wafer-scale TFLN process development. Roadmap: NeuraWave commercial launch, Dirac-3 benchmarking and QKD system in 2026, a 110 GHz-bandwidth electro-optic modulator in 2026-2027, QKD plus quantum authentication in early 2027, 3D integration of TFLN and silicon photonics in 2027-2029 and a chip-integrated quantum and photonics processing unit in 2028-2029. Estimated Fab 2 and other capital expenditures are $70M-$90M (H1 2026 capex $4.5M).
quarterly_data.figure: NeuraWave commercial launch 2026; estimated Fab 2 and other capex $70M-$90M
